notes: Stage 4 Model C: Model B plus per-division cell death at the post-8-cell phase. Apoptosis is a documented blastocyst phenomenon (Hardy 1989, S-6) making cell death real at these stages, but its RATE is not measured -- 0.05/division is a stated assumption, not a fit. The A/B/C comparison tests whether death of the documented order, without any cycle tuning, helps reconcile the day 5-7 counts that B under/over-shoots. Sensitivity sweeps death 0.0-0.20.
